name: Yellowstone National Park
summary: The world's first national park, sitting on a supervolcano — geysers and rainbow springs, a golden canyon, and valleys teeming with bison, wolves, and bears. A big, unmissable stay.

lodging.blurb: The great log lodge by the geyser — book a year ahead.

foodMustTry.blurb: Hearty park fare between the geysers.
